sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders come into the fixture off the back of a recent loss but remain unbeaten in their longer-term form, having won seven of their last ten matches. Alsager Town are bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once in their last five outings, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a stern test away at Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the 2-point gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in a fixture between two sides in respectable form—Bridgnorth have won three of their last four, while sixth-placed Eccleshall sit just one point behind in the table. Fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter, with the hosts in mixed recent form. Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points, host Foley Meir in what should be a competitive clash. The fixture list also includes Brereton Social v Widnes Town (bottom of the league with 2 points), Cheadle Heath Nomads v Telford Town (both struggling near the foot of the table), Crewe v Allscott Heath (mid-table sides), Shawbury United v Barnton (Shawbury on a six-game losing run against in-form Barnton), and Market Drayton Town v New Mills (two mid-table sides). Additionally, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a Wednesday evening fixture on 7 October at 19:45.
